project_type: Multi-system emulator. Rust core engine (crates/emulator-bridge) compiled to WASM for a web PWA and to native ARM64 for iOS via a UniFFI Swift facade. Phase 5 adds a native libretro loader and an iOS build pipeline (native/ios/) whose only compiler is GitHub Actions on macos-latest.
language: Rust (engine), C/C++ (libretro cores + switch-wrapper), Swift (iOS shell), Bash (build scripts), YAML (CI).
build_system: Cargo workspace pinned to Rust 1.92.0 (rust-toolchain.toml). iOS engine builds with `cargo build --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings` (custom [profile.ios] inherits release but sets panic=unwind; artefacts land in target/aarch64-apple-ios/ios/, NOT .../release/). Cores for the web build via scripts/build-core.sh with wasi-sdk. PS1 core for iOS must build from source on the macOS runner with Xcode clang, NOT wasi-sdk.
test_framework: cargo test (74 unit tests, run in the not(target_arch=wasm32) config which is the same config iOS uses). C++ wrapper harness: native/switch-wrapper/build.sh host (15 checks, dlopens the .so and drives it like a frontend).
build_command: cargo build --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings (iOS engine, macOS only for link; type-checks on Linux via cargo check). Web: scripts/build-wasm.sh. On the macOS CI runner the full iOS path is native/ios/build-engine.sh then native/ios/package-ipa.sh.
verification_instructions: In this Linux sandbox, all of these must pass: (1) cargo test  [was 74 passing]; (2) cargo check --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings; (3) cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings; (4) cargo clippy --features native-core,uniffi-bindings --all-targets  [must be clean; CI runs it with -D warnings]; (5) ./native/switch-wrapper/build.sh host  [15/15 harness, needs .work/hdr/libretro headers first via ./scripts/fetch-libretro-headers.sh]. The scripts/build-core.sh PS1 path, native/ios/build-engine.sh, native/ios/package-ipa.sh and the macOS .ipa build CANNOT run here (no macOS/Xcode) and are verified BY EYE: trace every artefact path and the CI verify grep list for internal consistency. The actual macOS build and on-device PS1 boot are verified only by the orchestrator's CI run afterward.
snapshot_or_generated_files: UniFFI Swift bindings are generated by native/ios/build-engine.sh into native/ios/build/Generated/ (gitignored, never committed - a stale checked-in binding is the worst failure mode). The .xcodeproj is generated by xcodegen from native/ios/project.yml (gitignored). Cores and .work/ / .tools/ are gitignored. No generated files are committed for this task.
setup_instructions: rustup toolchain is auto-installed from rust-toolchain.toml (1.92.0 with clippy, rustfmt, targets wasm32-unknown-unknown and aarch64-apple-ios - already installed in this sandbox). For the switch-wrapper harness, run ./scripts/fetch-libretro-headers.sh once to populate .work/hdr/libretro/ (network to raw.githubusercontent.com works in this sandbox).
environment_constraints: Network is restricted but raw.githubusercontent.com IS reachable (verified: fetch-libretro-headers.sh succeeds). No macOS, no Xcode, no iOS SDK, no MoltenVK. Cannot link for aarch64-apple-ios (cargo check type-checks only). Cannot run build-core.sh's PS1 path (needs macOS clang + Xcode iOS SDK) - the real PCSX ReARMed source fetch and compile happen inside GitHub Actions on macos-latest. Cannot run native/ios/*.sh (they refuse on non-Darwin). The wasi-sdk web core path in build-core.sh is unaffected and must not be broken.
contribution_requirements: SESSION_HANDOFF.md is the canonical doc and MUST be updated with a Phase 5 Step 2 section. Do NOT push, commit to remote, open a PR, or trigger CI (the orchestrator does that). Keep the 74 cargo tests passing. Keep the 15/15 switch-wrapper harness passing (the stub wrapper remains embedded). Clippy must be clean under -D warnings. Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: The four architectural decisions (authoritative): (1) PCSX ReARMed (PS1) is the FIRST real core, de-risking loader+ROM+input+audio through the SOFTWARE frame path; (2) Thin Passthrough Loader (Option 1) - dlopen the core and forward retro_* directly, NOT through the switch-wrapper IoC FrameGate which stays reserved for the future Switch engine; (3) SOFTWARE rendering only for PS1 this step, NO MoltenVK/Vulkan; (4) compile PCSX ReARMed from source inside GitHub Actions via scripts/build-core.sh targeting aarch64-apple-ios. PCSX ReARMed GROUND TRUTH (from its master Makefile.libretro and frontend/libretro.c, read during planning): platform=ios-arm64 sets ARCH=arm64, BUILTIN_GPU=neon, DYNAREC=0 (lightrec/dynarec is FORCE-DISABLED for iOS arm64 - the first green build is INTERPRETER-only, no JIT dependency, lower perf but boots), TARGET=pcsx_rearmed_libretro_ios.dylib, GNU_LINKER=0, -Wl,-dead_strip, links with -shared, needs IOSSDK set. It declares need_fullpath=true UNCONDITIONALLY and hard-rejects load if info->path is NULL (frontend/libretro.c ~line 2010: 'info->path required'). It calls SET_PIXEL_FORMAT (cmd 10) INSIDE retro_load_game choosing XRGB8888 vs RGB565 from the pcsx_rearmed_rgb32_output option (default RGB565); if the host refuses it logs an error but keeps current_fmt. It issues 73 GET_VARIABLE (cmd 15) reads; unset/NULL returns are fine (core uses its defaults). It has an HLE BIOS fallback (pcsx_rearmed_bios option / Config.HLE) so it can boot with NO real BIOS in system dir, at reduced compatibility. valid_extensions = bin|cue|img|mdf|pbp|toc|cbn|m3u|chd|iso|exe. The existing native_core.rs on_environment answers only ~6 commands and hardcodes PixelFormat::Rgba8888 in video() - both must change.
